command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== STEP 1: write logrotate config =="
sudo -n tee /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app >/dev/null <<'EOF'
/var/log/inventory/app.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    copytruncate
    dateext
}
EOF
cat /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app

echo "== STEP 2: syntax check (dry run) =="
sudo -n logrotate -d /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app 2>&1

echo "== STEP 3: capture baseline content =="
cat /var/log/inventory/app.log
stat -c '%s %Y' /var/log/inventory/app.log

echo "== STEP 4: force rotate to prove it works =="
sudo -n logrotate -f -v /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app 2>&1

echo "== STEP 5: verify rotation results =="
ls -la /var/log/inventory/

echo "== STEP 6: simulate app continuing to write after rotation =="
echo "post-rotation-write-$(date +%s)" | sudo -n tee -a /var/log/inventory/app.log >/dev/null
cat /var/log/inventory/app.log
ls -la /var/log/inventory/
